title: Sound check: the new two-host Morning Brief
lede: A short test of the new format. Two hosts instead of one voice, and a written news page with every episode. The first real brief arrives tomorrow before 9am.

stories.headline: What's new in the brief
stories.summary: Each morning the brief is researched, written as a conversation between two hosts and voiced with OmniVoice, the open-source engine behind VoiceStudio. It still runs about five minutes: markets first, then six to eight stories that matter, each with a line on why it matters to you.
stories.why: You get the same information in less time, in a format that's easier to keep listening to, plus a written version to skim.

watch: Tomorrow's first real two-host brief, in your inbox before 9am.
